translation:
[#P04After] you search a point, the singularity will
appear as a pin.

[#P04Singularities] appear in spaces whose data
links have become unstable.

[#P04They] reinforce alternate space using Haruhi
Suzumiya's desires and fantasies.

[#P04For] this reason, singularities come in a
variety of different forms.

[#P04By] scrubbing singularities with the mop that
Yuki Nagato enhanced…

[#P04When] you rub them with your stylus, the
brigade member will automatically move next to it.

[#P04They] will take out the mop and start
scrubbing it.

[#P04Keep] rubbing it with the stylus until the
singularity has been completely erased.

[#P04If] you stop rubbing before it's been
completely erased…
[#P04]…the singularity will restore itself over time.

[#P04This] auto-recovery can happen in any
situation.

[#P04It] will even occur during Delay Events, or
Accidents…

[#P04So] please check the top screen before
rubbing so you can get the timing right.

[#P04When] you're rubbing a singularity, use a wider
sweeping motion—
[#P04That] way you can erase it more efficiently.
